intro: Technology and cybersecurity sectors bore the brunt of 70 ai-security incidents tracked between April and August 2026, with global impact and significant effects across the United States, North America, and China. Threat actors Claude Mythos and OpenClaw were observed in these campaigns. Key vulnerabilities included CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8), CVE-2026-5752 (CVSS 9.3), CVE-2026-44339 (CVSS 8.6), CVE-2026-44567 (CVSS 7.7), and CVE-2026-45303 (CVSS 7.7). Government, critical infrastructure, and financial services also faced exposure. The severity mix comprised 32 high, 9 critical, 14 informational, and 6 medium incidents.
